integrity: Standalone executable finite proof checks are included; the reported homotopy and symmetry statements have been subjected to same-model review only.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite Desargues nonincidence graph only; no all-configurations classification, no equivariant sphere-wedge splitting, and no integral S5 lattice description. Some older plausible primary works were accessible only as abstracts; unindexed equivalents remain possible.
title: Mixed-dimensional homotopy and symmetric-group homology of the Desargues nonincidence neighborhood complex
